neighbours.label: the 'admit/admission' word family (admit, admitted, admittedly, admission), including its 'mit'/'mitted'/'mission' pieces after 'Ad'
fire: To be fair, the hotel was cheap. Admittedly, the room was very small.
The patient was admitted to the clinic late on Friday night.
Students pay no admission fee for the concert this weekend.
After an hour of questions, the suspect finally admitted the theft.
My sister rarely admits that she is wrong about anything.
The college sent out its admissions letters in early April.
Only adults are admitted to the bar after nine in the evening.
He hated admitting defeat, but the chess match was clearly lost.
quiet: To be fair, the hotel was cheap. Honestly, the room was very small.
The patient was transferred to the clinic late on Friday night.
Students pay no entry fee for the concert this weekend.
After an hour of questions, the suspect finally confessed to the theft.
My sister has submitted three essays to the magazine this year.
The college sent out its permission forms in early April.
Only adults are allowed in the bar after nine in the evening.
He hated losing, but the chess match was clearly over by the end.

notes: Layer 2. Probes: Admittedly 0.93, admitted 0.66, Admission 0.89; submitted, mission and permitted all ~0.
